functions.name: decode
functions.spark_sql:
SELECT id,
    DECODE(b, ' uTf-8 ') AS decoded,
    TO_CHAR(b, 'utf-8') AS formatted,
    TO_VARCHAR(b, 'utf-8') AS varchar_value,
    DECODE(b, CASE WHEN id % 2 = 0 THEN 'UTF-8' ELSE 'ISO-8859-1' END) AS dynamic_charset
FROM bench WHERE id < 24
functions.class_evidence: Explicit native reference candidate; both ANSI comparisons and native registry/physical evidence must pass before any timing. Same spelling alone supplies no equivalence evidence.
